runs.config.yml:
auth_enabled: false

server:
  http_listen_port: 3100
  log_level: info

common:
  path_prefix: /loki
  storage:
    filesystem:
      chunks_directory: /loki/chunks
      rules_directory: /loki/rules
  replication_factor: 1
  ring:
    kvstore:
      store: inmemory

schema_config:
  configs:
    - from: 2024-01-01
      store: boltdb-shipper
      object_store: filesystem
      schema: v11
      index:
        prefix: index_
        period: 24h

storage_config:
  index_cache_validity: 5s
  boltdb_shipper:
    shared_store: filesystem
    active_index_directory: /loki/index
    cache_location: /loki/cache
    resync_interval: 5s
  filesystem:
    directory: /loki/chunks

limits_config:
  allow_structured_metadata: false
  retention_period: 168h
  reject_old_samples: false
  # Enforce logical expiry even while local writer/chunk caches converge.
  max_query_lookback: 168h
  ingestion_rate_mb: 2
  ingestion_burst_size_mb: 4
  max_query_series: 1000
  max_entries_limit_per_query: 5000

compactor:
  working_directory: /loki/compactor
  shared_store: filesystem
  compaction_interval: 5s
  retention_enabled: true
  retention_delete_delay: 1s
  retention_delete_worker_count: 2

querier:
  query_ingesters_within: 0s

ingester:
  chunk_idle_period: 1s
  max_chunk_age: 1m
  chunk_retain_period: 0s
  flush_check_period: 1s

runs.config.yml:
auth_enabled: false

server:
  http_listen_port: 3100
  log_level: info

common:
  path_prefix: /loki
  storage:
    filesystem:
      chunks_directory: /loki/chunks
      rules_directory: /loki/rules
  replication_factor: 1
  ring:
    kvstore:
      store: inmemory

schema_config:
  configs:
    - from: 2024-01-01
      store: boltdb-shipper
      object_store: filesystem
      schema: v11
      index:
        prefix: index_
        period: 24h

storage_config:
  index_cache_validity: 5s
  boltdb_shipper:
    shared_store: filesystem
    active_index_directory: /loki/index
    cache_location: /loki/cache
    resync_interval: 5s
  filesystem:
    directory: /loki/chunks

limits_config:
  allow_structured_metadata: false
  retention_period: 168h
  reject_old_samples: false
  ingestion_rate_mb: 2
  ingestion_burst_size_mb: 4
  max_query_series: 1000
  max_entries_limit_per_query: 5000

compactor:
  working_directory: /loki/compactor
  shared_store: filesystem
  compaction_interval: 5s
  retention_enabled: true
  retention_delete_delay: 1s
  retention_delete_worker_count: 2

querier:
  query_ingesters_within: 0s

ingester:
  chunk_idle_period: 1s
  max_chunk_age: 1m
  chunk_retain_period: 0s
  flush_check_period: 1s
